parameters.note: How far back Progress's weight chart reads the 7-day average (K-979): twelve weeks (progress_grid_weeks, windows.yaml: the weeks the record is read over). The chart is drawn only from the points the server has in this window.

How many of the latest calls Progress's Calls card lists (K-979): twelve, one call a week over the same weeks (progress_grid_weeks, windows.yaml). The ledger screen is off the surface (ADR-069 #3), so Progress is where calls are read.

How many of the calls Progress lists open at first (K-1246, ADR-094 Ek 3 #7): the latest three; 'and N more' opens the rest of calls_shown in the same card, as the Train tab's today card does (Ek 2 › Uygulama #7).

The weight chart's ranges on Progress (K-1260): the first is weight_chart_days (the default, read with the rest of Progress); a year is free as the weigh-in screen's Year already was (health.json weigh_in_history_days); 'all' (days null: everything) comes with a subscription. ADR-096 Ek 1, Levent 28 Nov.

The strength chart's ranges (K-1260): the first is the server's weeks over the evaluation window (workout.json evaluation_window_days, 90), free as today; six months, a year and all come with a subscription, read from the move's paged history (K-1259).
'All' of the weight trend is read back in windows of this many days (the server answers fewer than keel.api.max-range-days, 400, per request), until a window has no point.
